For each pin whose caption states a street address, the address was geocoded (GSI for Japanese script, Photon housenumber hits elsewhere) and compared with the pin. Coordinates are what the pin held when checked; a moved pin invalidates its row. Not read by any check; a record so the sweep is not redone blind.
